rfp.subject: Leadership offsite request, 18 guests, 2 nights from 2027-06-02
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are requesting a proposal for a leadership offsite.

Dates: arrival 2027-06-02, 2 nights (departure 2027-06-04).
Guests: 18, in single-occupancy rooms (36 room nights).
Meeting space: one plenary meeting room for 18 for both days; breakout rooms are not required.
Catering: day delegate package (lunch, coffee) plus meals as available.
Dietary: 3 vegan, 2 gluten-free.
Accessibility: 1 wheelchair user. We need a step-free route, an accessible bedroom and an accessible bathroom.
Budget: up to EUR 12,000 in total.

Please send your availability, a full quote and your terms by 2026-10-30.

Thank you.
